raw_text:
This Telegram bot template uses aiogram 3, Django 5, and Celery. Starter scaffold: `/start` and user tracking.

cp .env.example .env  # Then edit .env with your values
uv run python manage.py migrate
uv run python manage.py createsuperuser
uv run python manage.py runserver
uv run python main.py
uv run celery -A config worker --loglevel=info
uv run python manage.py makemigrations
uv run python manage.py test
uv run python manage.py createsuperuser
uv run python manage.py shell

`.env`: `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN` and `DJANGO_SECRET_KEY` required; `CELERY_BROKER_URL`, `START_COMMAND_MESSAGE`.

`main.py` initializes Django, configures aiogram, middleware/routes, and polling. `config/` provides settings, database, Celery, and admin. `bot/models.py` stores `TelegramUser`; `bot/aiogram/handlers.py` contains handlers; `middlewares.py` tracks users; `tasks.py` contains Celery tasks.

Add handlers/router modules via `main.py:42`; models in `bot/models.py`, register in `bot/admin.py`; tasks use `<REDACTED_USER>_task`; add environment variables to `.env.example`, access via `config/settings.py`. Use `uv`. Admin: `/admin`. Redis is required for Celery.
